bio: The Cricketers is an award-winning British gastropub on the Green and is the heart of the local community of Pirbright, Surrey.  A delectable selection of sweet treats and savoury delights await, complete with freshly baked scones, clotted cream and preserves.  The Cricketers on the Green offers a variety of dining spaces, full of character and charm. Why not book your own private Afternoon Tea party, hosted in the characterful surroundings of the Garden Room, or smaller private dining room, The Cabernet Room.  The menu includes the highest quality, seasonal, farm to table ingredients packed into our traditional Afternoon Tea delights.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Saturday from from 12pm - 5pm and advance booking is recommended.
